title: Blue line is glitchy when transitioning between non-system-tray widgets
line: Switching from one open panel widget to another no longer shows two blue lines at once.
explanation: When another panel widget is clicked, its blue line appeared as soon as it was expanded, a few frames before its popup was on screen. The old popup closes only when it loses focus to the new one, and its expanded state (and line) is cleared another 100 ms later by the expandedSync timer, so both lines were visible for 3-4 frames. The line now follows the popup itself: it shows once the popup window has been activated and hides as soon as the popup window hides.

commits.message:
applet: don't show two expanded lines when switching panel popups

A new popup's line appeared before its window was shown, while the old
line stayed until a 100 ms timer collapsed its popup. Now the line only
shows while the popup is visible and after it has been activated.

BUG: 517066

media.caption: Master, animations off: Kickoff open, clock clicked; both blue lines visible while the clock popup appears
Patched, animations off: first frame with the clock line; Kickoff's line is already gone
Master, default animations: both lines in the same frame
Patched, default animations: only the clock line

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in CompactApplet.qml that addresses both halves of the dual-indicator glitch: hiding the old widget's blue line as soon as its popup hides (instead of waiting 100 ms for expandedSync) and delaying the new widget's line until its popup window is visible and activated. Latching activation into dialog.wasActive keeps the line visible for pinned popups that lose focus while preserving the expandedSync toggle guard. Before/after screenshots and frame-level verification with animations both off and on confirm the fix without regressions.

The diagnosis holds: the new applet's line followed plasmoidItem.expanded before its popup was on screen, while the old popup only hides when it loses focus to the new one and its expanded state lingers another 100 ms (expandedSync). Tying the line to dialog.visible plus a first activation makes both switch in the same frame, which is a small, contained change in CompactApplet.qml. The frame-measured before/after shots confirm it (pixel spans at the panel edge go from Kickoff+clock to clock only), and the pinned, shortcut, Escape and re-click cases were checked. Nit: a popup that opens without being activated (e.g. spring-loaded during a drag-and-drop) won't show its line until it's focused; worth a quick check, but it doesn't block the fix.
